mapper.select: SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.location_id, f.festival_nm, fd.year FROM festival f LEFT JOIN festival_detail fd ON f.festival_id = fd.festival_id WHERE f.location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY f.festival_nm, fd.year
SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.location_id, f.festival_nm, fd.year FROM festival f LEFT JOIN festival_detail fd ON f.festival_id = fd.festival_id ORDER BY f.festival_nm, fd.year
SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.location_id, f.festival_nm, fd.year FROM festival f LEFT JOIN festival_detail fd ON f.festival_id = fd.festival_id WHERE f.festival_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
